edge_gate: post_translational, consensus direction and exactly one sign, references present, single gene symbols; gene-edge duplicates with inconsistent signs excluded; self-loop excluded
complex_rule: LR receptor components remain all-required in native RNA eligibility; prior may connect through any one signaling component, not proof assembled receptor; intermediate complexes excluded instead of being split
path_gate: only shortest paths <=3, all shortest signs counted across real TF family members/complex footprint names; sign ambiguity explicit, candidate compatibility only
independent_audit: alternative bounded path enumeration, separate raw reconstruction, all receptor/TF/sign/count rows; no producer import
privacy: reference vectors no patients; complete graph/prior kept private for resource licence, public counts/SHA/algorithm
